# Primer - a patient tutor for young learners

> Primer is an open source adaptive tutor for young children: reading, writing and arithmetic. It adapts to each child's skill level, is free and private, and needs no account. Built by Siva Dheeraj.

## Parts
- / - landing page
- /app - the learning app (reading, writing, arithmetic practice that adapts by skill)
- /toolkit - teacher and parent toolkit: worksheets, quizzes, lesson plans, grading, study helpers and printables

## Facts
- Free, no account, no children's personal data collected
- Open source: https://github.com/Sivadheeraj5356/primer
